category: geographic reference data and IP geolocation API

free_tier.stated: Free plan, USD 0 a month: 1,000 requests a month at 5 requests a minute, with countries and states data and no expiry; IP geolocation, cities, global search and live currency rates are on a 14-day full-access trial given to every new account, then on the Basic plan at USD 19 a month (15,000 requests a month, 30 a minute)
free_tier.notes: Starter is USD 29 a month for 100,000 requests and Professional USD 79 for 500,000; the quota is a hard cap and the API answers HTTP 429 once it is reached.

egress.terms: not applicable: JSON answers, not metered in bytes

interface_detail: GET https://api.apogeoapi.com/v1/ip/{ip} with an X-API-Key header answers JSON; a call without a key answers HTTP 401
tooling: any HTTP client; quickstarts for cURL, JavaScript, Python and PHP; X-RateLimit-Remaining and Retry-After headers on 429 answers
chaining: IP geolocation is free for the 14-day trial only; after that it needs Basic, USD 19 a month; the free plan keeps countries and states data at 1,000 requests a month. Bulk path: none stated.

limits.value: 1,000 requests a month on the Free plan; hard-capped, HTTP 429 once reached
5 requests a minute on the Free plan

binding_note: the IP geolocation module is open for 14 days only; after that the 1,000 requests a month of the Free plan cover countries and states, not IP lookups.

identity_cost.detail: an account with email sign-up; no credit card for the trial

reliability_note: the monthly quota is a hard cap with HTTP 429 until the next cycle; email alerts at 80% and 100% usage; a keyless call answered HTTP 401 with a Spanish message
confidence_note: The pricing, documentation, sign-up and terms pages were quoted on 2026-11-02 and a keyless call answered HTTP 401; no keyed lookup was made, so the trial lookups were not exercised.
